title: Zero-Cost Betting Edge Discovery — Information & Market Timing
summary: Reasonable zero-cost information and timing signals were exhausted on the frozen five-league temporal benchmark. The selected model underperformed the de-vigged market on Brier and Log Loss, had negative ROI and CLV, and was not stable across walk-forward periods. Cross-book observations also lack deployable row-level timestamps.
next_action: Keep production unchanged. Resume only when a legal timestamped longitudinal zero-cost signal is available, and continue to require robust OOS market outperformance.
